author: Julie Pierantoni
text: Love it. I’ve used libre CGM 5+ years. My libre estimated A1C and lab A1C are 0.1-0.2 differences. My parents age 81 and 87 also use libre. It’s a game changer. No fingerstick can give as much information as a CGM
